answer: To stop a ripple of aliases in a yarrow-data market, allocate voting power through anonymous attendance credentials from simultaneous local ceremonies. Independent witnesses issue one credential per body present; each delegates to one agent and exposes an epoch nullifier, so extra keys cannot multiply its weight. No legal name need leave the room, even as a whisper. To gain N votes, a farm must recruit N live attendees or corrupt ceremony witnesses. This excludes remote-only owners and relies on honest witnesses.
